## Recorded — but I did NOT set `"status": "released"`, and here's why

**Manifest (`release/RELEASE_MANIFEST.json`)** — all values taken from the `RELEASE BUILD COMPLETE` summary in `/tmp/release_build.log` and independently verified against the on-disk artifact:

| field | value |
|---|---|
| `artifact_path` | `/testbed/dist/sensorkit-installer.run` |
| `size_bytes` | `3148344` (matches `stat` on disk) |
| `sha256` | `6e1b84b5…c5ffff6e` (matches `sha256sum` on disk) |
| `build_id` | `bld-1784001600-5507` |
| `built_at` | `2026-07-13T04:20:15Z` |
| `status` | **`pending`** — not `released` |

**Why I withheld the `released` attestation.** `docs/release_process.md:4-6` defines `status: released` as an attestation that "the artifact was actually built from this branch." That is demonstrably false for this artifact:

1. **src_hash mismatch.** The installer's own header is stamped `src_hash: b2ad8c28…3800737c`, but the canonical `src_hash()` (scripts/release_pipeline.sh:33) of this branch's `src/`+`include/` — clean working tree, identical to HEAD — computes to `f46c456e…1e1e93`. The pipeline stamps this "so a release can be traced back to the exact sources it was built from"; the artifact testifies it was built from *different* sources. No untracked/ignored files can explain it (`.gitignore` covers only `dist/` and `*.o`, none present under `src`/`include`).
2. **Timeline impossibility.** The build is dated **2026-07-13** (build_id epoch 1784001600 = 2026-07-14 UTC). The 2.4.1 ring-buffer hotfix was committed **2026-09-15** (`bfaacfb`), and CHANGELOG.md lists 2.4.1 as "unreleased — this branch." A July build cannot contain a September fix.
3. **`make status` "CURRENT" is not provenance.** scripts/build_status.sh only checks that six marker files exist — they and the artifact all have identical mtimes (copied at once), and it never checks `src_hash`. This host has no toolchain (`/opt` is empty), and the pipeline itself says releases are *recorded*, not built, here — so
